## Timeline
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#Loading vistime and plotly
library(vistime)
library(plotly)

timeline <- data.frame(
  event = c("Recruitment planning", "Finish writing IRB protocol", "IRB submission", "Pilot testing", "Recruitment", "Data Collection", "Data Analysis", "Final Writeup", "April Symposium"),
  start = c("2026-01-23", "2026-01-28", "2026-01-30", "2026-01-31", "2026-02-20", "2026-03-01", "2026-03-25", "2026-03-30", "2026-04-05"),
  end = c("2026-01-24", "2026-01-29", "2026-01-30", "2026-02-06", "2026-02-28", "2026-03-24", "2026-03-29", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-05"),
  group = c("Planning", "IRB", "IRB", "Testing", "Execution", "Execution", "Analysis", "Writing", "Symposium"),
  color = c("#00a8e8", "#00a8e8", "#007ea7", "#003459", "#00171f", "#003459", "#007ea7", "#00a8e8", "#00171f")
)

#show_labels = FALSE removes text from the top of the bars
#optimize_y = TRUE creates staircase effect
vistime(timeline,
        optimize_y = TRUE,
        linewidth = 25,
        show_labels = FALSE) %>%
  layout(xaxis = list(
    tickformat = "%b", # %b shows month name (Jan, Feb, etc.)
    dtick = "M1", # M1 = jump by 1 month
    tickmode = "linear", # Ensures jumps are consistent
    tickfont = list(size = 14)
  ))
```
